channel.title: Crisp & Counter — guides
channel.description: Air-fryer and thermometer buying guides, with each product link checked against the live Amazon listing.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Two appliances share a name and almost nothing else. These are the differences that change how a weeknight goes, and the ones that only look like they do.

item.title: Two baskets or one: is dual-zone worth the counter space?
item.description: A second drawer is the most seductive feature in the category. It is also the one most often bought for a dinner you cook twice a month.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air-fryer capacity
item.description: The quart figure on the box answers a question you did not ask. This is the version you did ask.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: The parts you wash and the space it occupies decide whether you keep using it. Both are checkable in about five minutes.

item.title: Meal-prep Sunday: one basket, two, or an oven?
item.description: Meal prep fails on geometry, not motivation. Count how many things need the appliance at once \u2014 then choose the shape that matches that number.

item.title: Small kitchen, big appliance: a five-minute space audit
item.description: Before you compare capacities, find out what your kitchen will actually let you own. It is a shorter list than you think.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Multi-function usually means one thing done well and several done acceptably. The trick is finding out which is which before it takes a shelf.

item.title: Do you need a meat thermometer for an air fryer?
item.description: An air fryer is very good at browning and completely blind to the middle. A probe is how you fix the second part.

item.title: Hosting with an air fryer: what actually scales
item.description: The appliance that feeds two beautifully is not automatically the one that feeds eight. Here is where the arithmetic changes.

item.title: Will your air fryer fit the holiday sides without a queue?
item.description: Plan backward from serving time: check the tray, count the batches, and give the meals you already cook more weight than the number on the box.
